test_item:
Timestamp is a number but stored as string in configuration file
(TimeStamp is greater than or equal to the stored value; AuthData is accepted)
pre:
1. DUT is connected via ADB with root permission (Dev/Eng build)
2. SAM dongle is inserted into the DUT
proc:
1. Read /data/vendor/dauth/ts on the DUT
$ adb shell cat /data/vendor/dauth/ts
2. PENDING: X-g SAM AuthData package with a newer TimeStamp + trigger
3. Read /data/vendor/dauth/ts on the DUT
$ adb shell cat /data/vendor/dauth/ts
er:
1. The adb shell cat /data/vendor/dauth/ts output shows the stored timestamp
2. PENDING: X-g SAM AuthData package with a newer TimeStamp + trigger
3. The adb shell cat /data/vendor/dauth/ts output shows the updated timestamp
design: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
